set_debug_level: set the CompilerGym debug level to control logging verbosity across the process
get_debug_level: get the current CompilerGym debug level from the COMPILER_GYM_DEBUG environment variable
get_logging_level: get the current Python logging level derived from the active debug level
logging_level_to_debug_level: convert a Python logging level integer to a CompilerGym debug level
review_debug_util: review the debug_util module to understand debug level to logging level mappings
